chunks: Will you not fight those who broke their pledge and plotted to banish the Apostle, and who were the first to attack you? Are you afraid of them? If you are believers, you should fear God more.
ai.seo_question: Why did God command the Muslims to fight the Quraysh in Surah At-Tawbah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the Treaty of Hudaybiyyah, highlighting the Quraysh's treachery as a justification for the eventual conquest of Mecca. It establishes the principle that fear of God (khawf Allah) supersedes fear of creation, a key concept in understanding the political and spiritual authority of the Imams. The verse underscores the transition from defensive patience to active enforcement of divine justice against those who violate covenants.
